INSERT INTO content_errors (job_id, severity, error_code, error_message, recoverable, context)
VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid, COALESCE('{{$json.severity}}','warning'), COALESCE('{{$json.error_code}}','STEP_FAILED'), COALESCE('{{$json.error_message}}',''), true, jsonb_build_object('step_name',COALESCE('{{$json.step_name}}','unknown'),'retry_safe','retry_count < max_retries','retry_count',COALESCE('{{$json.retry_count}}','0')));
